patch.objective: Evaluating and choosing business technology solutions
secondaryObjectives: Technical writing for information systems documentation

sources.cite: David Bourgeois, Information Systems for Business and Beyond (2019 edition), Part 2 (chapter 7 'Does IT Matter?', chapter 8 'Business Processes')
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of the LibreTexts copy: chapter 7 looks at 'the value IT can bring to an organization' and whether IT spending improves productivity and competitiveness; chapter 8 calls process 'the fourth component of information systems'. The page did not itself discuss strategic alignment or the business case; those decisions are the base case's, as its own sources state. The CMPCBS course cites this textbook for its Introduction to Information Systems unit.

sources.cite: ISACA, CISM Exam Content Outline (exam from 2026-11-03): Domain 1 Information Security Governance; Domain 2 Information Security Risk Management; Domain 3 Information Security Program
sources.note: Read as HTML on 2026-11-14 for REQ-272 and not re-read. Domain 1 part B covers the information security strategy and the business case, budget and resources; Domain 2 part B covers risk treatment against the risk appetite; Domain 3 part B covers program metrics reported to senior leadership. The course's objective wording is its own.

sources.cite: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 (NIST CSWP 29, February 26, 2024), GOVERN function: GV.RM-01, GV.RM-02, GV.RR-02, GV.OV
sources.note: Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch of NIST's 'CSF 2.0 Implementation Examples' PDF (dated February 26, 2024), which restates the Core outcomes: GV.RM-02 'Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained'; GV.RR-02 'Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced'; GV.OV 'Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy'. The CSWP 29 document itself was not opened.
